test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Hitler’s concentration camps _____________ the bodies of the dead captives subsequently.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (4)** i.e. '**mutilated'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mutilated : (किसी के शरीर का बुरी तरह अंग-भंग कर देना)**** **- to damage somebody’s body very badly, often by cutting off parts.

 
 
• **Example: **The original manuscript was mutilated over the centuries.
 
 
 
• Hence, 'mutilated' is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Therefore, the complete sentence is *"Hitler’s concentration camps **mutilated**__ the bodies of the dead captives subsequently."* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ **

 
• **Conspired : (षड्यंत्र किया) **- Make secret plans jointly to commit an unlawful or harmful act.

 
 
• **Example: **They conspired to take over the company.
 
 
 
• **Exaggerated : (अतिरेकीत)** - Represent something as being larger, better, or worse than it really is.
 
 
• **Example: **He exaggerated his experience on his resume.
 
 
 
• **Resounded : (प्रतिध्वनित हुआ)** - Fill a place with sound; be loud enough to echo.
 
 
• **Example:** The hall resounded with laughter.
